annoyed.instructions: A user typed this message to an AI coding assistant (code blocks and markup were removed). Rate how frustrated or annoyed the user sounds. Judge tone and wording only (caps, swearing, 'again', 'why did you', 'stop', 'wtf', exasperation), not task difficulty. Plain instructions or questions are neutral.

target.instructions: If the user sounds annoyed, what is the annoyance aimed at?

criteria.assistant: the AI's own behavior in this session: what it did, wrote, ignored, repeated, took too long on, or misunderstood (incl. reacting to its output with 'wtf', 'no', 'stop', 'again', 'why did you')
criteria.other: build tools, third-party libraries/services, pre-existing code or tests, the user's own past design, other people, or general product/UX feedback about the thing being built
criteria.none: not annoyed: a plain question, instruction, design musing, or casual chat
